title: Second moment on the uniform sign cube
statement: For every real-valued function $f$ on the sign cube $\{−1,1\}^n$, its second moment under the uniform product distribution on that cube equals the uniform-cube expectation $\mathbb{E}_x[f(x)^2]$.
